newsitem.title: FRANCE: French kill one in shoot-out with Bangui rebels.
newsitem.headline: French kill one in shoot-out with Bangui rebels.

text.p: French troops killed one local army mutineer and captured another during a new shoot-out between French soldiers and rebels in the Central African Republic capital of Bangui on Thursday, a French army spokesman said in Paris.
There were no French casualties, the spokesman told Reuters.

The clash occurred when a French patrol came face-to-face with a group of a dozen mutineers who had been extorting money from African civilians in a neighbourhood two km (over a mile) from their Camp Kasai stronghold, the French spokesman said.
The rebels, armed with AK-47 assault rifles and RPG-7 grenade launchers, opened fire at the French patrol which returned the fire, he said.
Three weapons were seized from the rebels, he said.

The clash was the latest in a series which reached a peak earlier this month when French helicopters strafed rebel positions after a French captain and a warrant officer were killed by rebels while accompanying an inter-African mediation team.
